decisions.cloud: primary compute/database deployment cloud undecided; approved managed providers may be selected independently behind adapters
decisions.messaging: RabbitMQ 4.3 current supported patch + PostgreSQL transactional outbox/inbox
decisions.object_storage: Cloudflare R2 primary via S3-compatible IObjectStorage and official AWS SDK for .NET; no local authoritative object-store emulator
decisions.browser_realtime: ASP.NET Core SignalR; Redis backplane when horizontally scaled
decisions.browser_typed_rpc: gRPC-Web selective for Tunner-owned web clients
decisions.internal_rpc: in-process default; native gRPC only across justified process boundaries
decisions.frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite + TailAdmin React; separate User/Admin applications
decisions.bff: separate ASP.NET Core User/Admin BFFs; secure cookie session; no browser JS OAuth token storage
decisions.git_ci: GitHub + GitHub Actions + Rulesets + OIDC + artifact attestations
decisions.transactional_email: Resend primary production adapter via official .NET SDK; Mailpit local/test; Mailgun approved alternate deferred
decisions.data_residency: no strict residency promise before approved jurisdiction policy; Product/environment data_region + residency-policy capability; R2 location hints are not guarantees and jurisdiction restrictions are used where supported
decisions.openapi: OpenAPI 3.1 normative executable contract on .NET 10; 3.2 forward target
decisions.local_observability: Grafana OTEL-LGTM for development/test; OpenTelemetry/OTLP remains application contract
decisions.account_eligibility: Tunner Accounts are 18+ only; registration collects DOB, backend performs calendar-safe 18+ calculation, under-18 activation is denied; raw DOB retention is policy-controlled (PDR-0007)
decisions.financial_services_registration_posture: market/provider activation requires the applicable financial-regulatory classification and provider/compliance gates; any additional regulated financial capability requires explicit approval before activation
decisions.commercial_reach: global eligible markets; customer/card geography is not the commercial boundary; every market remains provider/compliance/tax-policy gated
decisions.tax_market_policy: destination-market tax/privacy/marketing/consumer obligations are resolved per versioned market policy; provider technical acceptance is not legal-market authorization. Tax calculation is delegated to an ACTIVE approved managed ITaxEngine binding; Tunner does not maintain proprietary tax-rate/jurisdiction/taxability rules.
decisions.payment_provider: Stripe remains the initial payment-provider adapter; provider-neutral routing supports additional separately approved providers/accounts for continuity. A continuity claim requires at least two independently ACTIVE, charge-capable routes.
decisions.documentation_readiness: PD-CLOSE-03 and PD-CLOSE-05 are resolved by PDR-0009 and PDR-0010. Managed/extensible tax, configurable FX economics and guided financial configuration are locked; development remains blocked only by final FigJam/documentation alignment and closure audits.
decisions.connected_product_relationship: uniform Tunner service-consumer/integrator model governed by PDR-0008; service, commercial, payment, settlement and operational relationships are explicit and versioned
decisions.finance_scope: Tunner-managed Product transaction/payable economics, provider settlement/treasury FX evidence, fees, provider costs, tax evidence, ProductPayable/ProductPayableBalance, Settlement, Product payout preference/FX, Payout, reconciliation and platform financial-control ledger
decisions.product_commercial_agreement: versioned per Product; fee policies may differ by Product (for example percentage plus fixed amount) with immutable event-time evidence
decisions.payout_lifecycle: ProductPayable/ProductPayableBalance -> immutable Settlement (single payable currency) -> ProductPayoutPreference/ProductPayoutDestinationVersion -> optional evidenced FX -> Payout -> provider/bank finality -> PayoutReceipt -> reconciliation; PayoutProcessingCase is exception-only
decisions.notification_orchestration: Connected Products request Tunner-managed notifications through Tunner SDK/API; Tunner owns NotificationIntent, routing/provider interaction, delivery evidence and in-app notification state; Products do not call Tunner notification providers directly
decisions.product_finance_provider_separation: ProductPayable and ProductPayableBalance remain Product + Product commercial/payable-currency scoped; provider accounts/routing, settlement currency and treasury FX are separate execution/clearing/reconciliation infrastructure and never determine or re-denominate Product economic ownership (PDR-0006)
decisions.product_compliance: Tunner-managed ProductKycCase records Connected Product KYC/KYB/compliance eligibility for Tunner services; provider verification of Tunner's own merchant/account relationship is separate provider evidence (PDR-0006)
decisions.checkout_ownership: Tunner owns CheckoutOperation, commercial/tax context, state and final result. Provider adapters may use approved PCI-safe embedded components or provider-hosted presentation; provider routing remains internal and Product-facing contracts remain provider-neutral.
decisions.currency_model: configuration-driven ISO-4217 support. Product prices are explicit per enabled presentment currency; cardholder/account currency may differ. ProductPayable remains in the source Product commercial transaction/presentment currency in the initial model; provider settlement and Product payout currencies are separate governed dimensions.
planned_treasury_accounts: USD bank/treasury account (planned; unavailable until created, verified and activated)
decisions.checkout_orchestration: Tunner owns CheckoutOperation and final result. Provider adapters may use EMBEDDED_PROVIDER_COMPONENT or PROVIDER_HOSTED_REDIRECT. Provider route resolves before provider-specific payment-data collection/tokenization.
decisions.payment_continuity: new payments may route only to provider/accounts that are already ACTIVE and charge-capable. Holds, pending verification, restrictions or disabled capabilities remove a route from eligibility. Alternate routing is allowed only before external side effect, or after authoritative reconciliation proves a new attempt is safe.
decisions.customer_authentication: Tunner does not universally force 3-D Secure; provider/network/issuer-required authentication is supported through normalized REQUIRES_ACTION and resumes the same CheckoutOperation/PaymentTransaction.
decisions.provider_settlement_currency: ProviderSettlementProfile binds eligible provider/account + presentment context to settlement currency and active TunnerTreasuryAccount. Actual provider FX is immutable Tunner treasury/clearing evidence and does not re-denominate ProductPayable.
decisions.product_payable_currency: ProductPayable and ProductPayableBalance are Product + payable-currency scoped. In the initial model payable currency equals the source Product transaction/presentment currency from the immutable CommercialSnapshot and is independent of provider settlement currency.
decisions.product_payout_currency: ProductPayoutPreference is versioned and independent of Product country/customer presentment/provider settlement currency. Unsupported payout corridors block. Settlement-to-payout currency conversion requires immutable FxConversion evidence.
decisions.fx_evidence: Every actual provider settlement, payout, tax-remittance or policy-required accounting currency conversion is separately evidenced with source/target amounts and currencies, effective rate, provider/bank reference, timestamps and fees/spread when available. Provider-settlement FX remains treasury/clearing evidence unless an explicit Product economic-treatment policy authorizes a specific pass-through.
decisions.fx_economic_treatment: PDR-0010 RESOLVED. Cause-based platform defaults: customer/issuer FX EXTERNAL_TO_TUNNER; Tunner provider-settlement/treasury FX TUNNER_BORNE; Product-requested payout FX PRODUCT_BORNE; statutory/accounting translation REPORTING_ONLY. ProductCommercialAgreement may explicitly override Product-affecting treatment with PRODUCT_BORNE, TUNNER_BORNE or SHARED, using only actual externally evidenced costs.
decisions.tax_engine: Managed external tax services only through provider-neutral ITaxEngine. Stripe Tax via StripeTaxAdapter is the initial production adapter where supported. Additional approved managed tax services can be added as adapters without changing Product-facing or canonical Checkout/Invoice/Payment/Finance contracts (PDR-0009).
decisions.guided_financial_configuration: FX/payout policies are configured through guided, versioned/effective workflows with Standard Cause-Based templates, progressive disclosure, currency/corridor validation, financial previews, current-vs-candidate version review, approval/step-up and immutable audit evidence; normal operation does not require raw JSON or database editing.

governance_control_plane.governance_yaml: YamlDotNet stable 18.x; current stable patch at implementation
